title: CIA regressionists regress Burroughs from the Rendlesham case
place_text: New York (Sandler studio); Rendlesham Forest case

tellings.quote: I got guys I got two guys and they were CIA is regressionists that that regressed uh um Bros from the runners from forest case

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he knows of two men who worked for the CIA, the US spy agency, as 'regressionists', people who use hypnosis to bring back buried memories. He says that in the 1980s, at a New York studio tied to a man named Alan Sandler and linked to Bob Emenegger, they hypnotised John Burroughs, a witness in a famous UFO encounter in Rendlesham Forest in England. If true, it would mean the spy agency was quietly digging into what that witness saw.
